text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin are both racing? This is gonna be great!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I saw BNW at the Kikuka Sho, and it's always amazing when they face off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the stands for today's race, fans are anticipating an exciting showdown between Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So many fans called out to me on the way here, it was crazy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That means they have high hopes, right? I'll do my best and give them a race to remember!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I hope I can meet their expectations. I'm so nervous, it's making me feel all itchy!
choice_data_list: You've just got to go out there and achieve something great!
You've just got to go out there and achieve something great!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Okay, gotta do my best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I did what I could during training. All that's left is to get in the spirit… WOOHOO!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right, here I go! See you, Trainer!
